svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Mark important emails for attention. → Review unread emails to identify important messages

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Review unread emails to identify important messages. → Read important emails.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Tag emails needing later action so the task can be completed when available. → Reply to em
ails requiring a response when available.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Separate important recruiting or school messages from deal mail using different email acco
unts. → Avoid missing messages from recruiting teams.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Use an AI assistant to compose an email from the sender's main points. → Adjust the AI-gen
erated email draft before sending it.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Adjust the AI-generated email draft before sending it. → Send the prepared email.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Adjust font size when preparing an email. → Send the prepared email.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Make important sentences bold before sending an email. → Send the prepared email.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Avoid missing important messages due to spam classification, even at the cost of receiving
some spam. → Avoid missing messages from recruiting teams.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Compose a well-organized email from brief input using an assistant built into the email cl
ient. → Use an AI assistant to compose an email from the sender's main points.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Use AI to extract the main points of received emails. → Reduce the time spent reading ever
y email.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Highlight important keywords or details so the reader does not overlook them. → Read impor
tant emails.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Consider periodic summaries of batches of received emails as one way to reduce reading eff
ort. → Reduce the time spent reading every email.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Receive notifications for important messages if importance detection is sufficiently relia
ble. → Avoid missing messages from recruiting teams.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search emails as an essential daily capability. → Filter messages by tags, including throu
gh search.
